US.name: NOAA / NWS Aviation Weather Center + NOAA/NDBC/NOS
US.period: USA official observations: METAR/SPECI airport wind nationwide, including Alaska and Hawaii, plus NOAA/NDBC/NOS coastal-station wind speed, direction and gust in Florida. Airport sustained wind is a 2-minute mean; gusts are reported from the preceding 10 minutes and remain unavailable when absent. NDBC standard meteorological wind values are reported in m/s.

EE.name: Estonian Environment Agency / Keskkonnaagentuur
EE.period: Latest reported mean wind and gust; feed updates every 10 minutes.

SE.name: Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI)
SE.period: 10-minute mean wind reported hourly, and hourly maximum gust from SMHI stations. Collection every 10 minutes does not change the provider observation time.

CH.name: Source: MeteoSwiss / SwissMetNet ten-minute observations (provisional)
CH.period: Ten-minute mean wind and maximum one-second gust over the same ten-minute period; km/h converted to m/s. Native UTC observation time; provisional. Source: MeteoSwiss.

HU.name: HungaroMet / official ten-minute automatic station observations (provisional)
HU.period: HungaroMet: ten-minute mean wind (fs) and maximum two-second gust over ten minutes (fx), in m/s; instantaneous air temperature (t), in °C. Native UTC measurement times; operational data are provisional.

BE.name: Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium / RMI-KMI
BE.period: 10-minute mean wind at 10 m and maximum 3-second gust over the last ten minutes; provisional.

CA.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada / MSC
CA.period: Quality-checked 10-minute mean wind and measured instantaneous wind maximum over 10 minutes; missing maxima remain unavailable.

AD.name: Servei Meteorològic Nacional (Andorra) / Meteo.ad
AD.period: Official measured sustained wind at native station sensor height. Current gusts are unavailable; daily maxima are not used as current gusts.

SI.name: Agencija Republike Slovenije za okolje (ARSO) / automatic station measurements (provisional)
SI.period: ARSO ten-minute mean wind (ffavg_val), maximum wind gust over the same ten-minute interval (ffmax_val), mean direction and instantaneous air temperature (t). Native UTC interval-end times; automatic, provisional measurements.

ES.name: AEMET / Agencia Estatal de Meteorología
ES.period: Ten-minute mean wind and maximum gust over the preceding hour, reported hourly at native UTC observation times. Wind speeds converted from km/h to m/s; provisional.

PL.name: Institute of Meteorology and Water Management (IMGW-PIB)
PL.period: Measured mean wind and reported 10-minute gust; missing gust reports remain unavailable.

FI.name: Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI)
FI.period: 10-minute mean wind and reported 10-minute gust maximum.

NL.name: KNMI
NL.period: Official ten-minute observation table: mean wind in m/s, reported gusts converted from km/h. The table observation time is converted from Europe/Amsterdam to UTC; provisional.

MT.name: Malta International Airport / official WMO and airport observations
MT.period: Official measured station winds at native observation times. Wind units converted to m/s. Explicit SYNOP and METAR gusts supplement national means; missing gusts remain unavailable. Gust measurement periods are identified per station; delayed reports are marked after 90 minutes.

PT.name: IPMA / Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera
PT.period: Ten-minute mean wind at 10 m, reported hourly. Current gusts are not provided by this feed; missing values remain unavailable. Native UTC observation time; provisional.

DK.name: Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI)
DK.period: 10-minute mean wind and highest 3-second mean wind in the latest 10 minutes.

LU.name: MeteoLux / ANA Luxembourg-Findel Airport
LU.period: Two-minute mean wind at 10 m and highest 3-second gust over the preceding two minutes, from the runway-midpoint sensor. Published every minute; source observation time; provisional.

CY.name: Weather Data © Cyprus Department of Meteorology · CC BY 4.0
CY.period: Official measured station winds at native observation times. Wind units converted to m/s. Explicit SYNOP and METAR gusts supplement national means; missing gusts remain unavailable. Gust measurement periods are identified per station; delayed reports are marked after 90 minutes.

MK.name: Hydrometeorological Service (UHMR), North Macedonia / official SYNOP and airport observations
MK.period: Official national station wind, supplemented by WMO SYNOP and airport METAR/SPECI observations. Native observation times and periods are retained; reports are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Gusts are included only when explicitly reported, and missing gusts remain unavailable.

AT.name: GeoSphere Austria / TAWES ten-minute observations (provisional)
AT.period: Ten-minute mean wind and maximum gust over the same ten-minute period, in m/s. Native UTC observation time; provisional. Source: GeoSphere Austria.

SK.name: Slovak Hydrometeorological Institute / SHMÚ
SK.period: Official automatic-station one-minute scalar mean wind and measured one-minute maximum wind speed. Published in five-minute batches. Source SEČ/CET timestamps (UTC+1 throughout the year) are converted to UTC; provisional.

IS.name: Icelandic Meteorological Office (IMO)
IS.period: 10-minute automatic-station mean wind and reported gust.

UA.name: Ukrainian Hydrometeorological Center / official station map and SYNOP via NOAA
UA.period: Reported station wind speed in m/s; SYNOP winds are ten-minute means. Gusts are reported SYNOP maxima: 910 is the preceding ten minutes; 911 is the preceding six hours at 00/06/12/18 UTC or three hours at intermediate SYNOP times. Reports with other gust reference periods are excluded. Native observation times; three-hourly reports can be up to four hours old and are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Missing gusts remain unavailable; no daily maxima or model values are substituted.

LV.name: Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre (LVĢMC)
LV.period: Hourly station wind and maximum gust over the hour from the LVĢMC website. National-portal and three-hourly official SYNOP backups retain their native observation times.

RO.name: Administrația Națională de Meteorologie (ANM), Romania / official SYNOP and airport observations
RO.period: Official national station wind, supplemented by WMO SYNOP and airport METAR/SPECI observations. Native observation times and periods are retained; reports are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Gusts are included only when explicitly reported, and missing gusts remain unavailable.

FO.name: DMI / Faroe Islands municipal weather stations
FO.period: 10-minute mean wind and highest 3-second mean gust over the latest hour. Hourly gusts retain their own timestamp; missing values remain unavailable.

BG.name: National Institute of Meteorology and Hydrology (NIMH), Bulgaria / official SYNOP and airport observations
BG.period: Official national station wind, supplemented by WMO SYNOP and airport METAR/SPECI observations. Native observation times and periods are retained; reports are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Gusts are included only when explicitly reported, and missing gusts remain unavailable.

IE.name: Met Éireann – Irish Meteorological Service
IE.period: Hourly mean of 3-second wind speeds and maximum 3-second gust over the hour. Direction is the reported 3-second direction at the top of the hour.

GL.name: Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI)
GL.period: 10-minute mean wind and highest 3-second mean wind in the latest 10 minutes.

HR.name: DHMZ / Croatian Meteorological and Hydrological Service; official SYNOP and airport reports via DWD / NOAA AWC
HR.period: DHMZ published hourly temperature and wind. SYNOP: ten-minute mean wind and maximum gust in the preceding hour when reported. Airport METAR/SPECI gusts are explicitly reported gusts, not hourly maxima. Missing gusts remain unavailable.

RS.name: Republic Hydrometeorological Service of Serbia (RHMZ) / official SYNOP and airport observations
RS.period: Official national station wind, supplemented by WMO SYNOP and airport METAR/SPECI observations. Native observation times and periods are retained; reports are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Gusts are included only when explicitly reported, and missing gusts remain unavailable.

FR.name: Météo-France official national observations with SYNOP backup
FR.period: National six-minute observations when configured; official three-hourly SYNOP backup. Native mean-wind and gust periods are identified by station; missing gusts remain unavailable.

LT.name: Lithuanian Hydrometeorological Service (LHMT)
LT.period: Hourly measured wind speed, maximum hourly gust and direction.

NO.name: MET Norway
NO.period: 10-minute mean wind and reported hourly maximum gust from MET Norway stations.

GB.name: Official UK airport METAR/SPECI and Met Office SYNOP observations
GB.period: UK airport METAR/SPECI wind and gusts, plus hourly UK SYNOP wind and gusts distributed by DWD. Measurement periods are identified by station; missing gusts remain unavailable.

IT.name: Official Italian SYNOP and airport METAR/SPECI observations via DWD and NOAA AWC
IT.period: Official SYNOP: ten-minute mean wind at 10 m and maximum gust in the preceding hour. Airport METAR/SPECI: reported mean wind and gusts, with knots converted to m/s. The popup identifies the reporting network; missing gusts remain unavailable.

TR.name: Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü (MGM), Türkiye
TR.period: Official measured station winds at native observation times. Wind units converted to m/s. Explicit SYNOP and METAR gusts supplement national means; missing gusts remain unavailable. Gust measurement periods are identified per station; delayed reports are marked after 90 minutes.

AL.name: Official Albanian WMO station observations / official SYNOP and airport observations
AL.period: Official national station wind, supplemented by WMO SYNOP and airport METAR/SPECI observations. Native observation times and periods are retained; reports are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Gusts are included only when explicitly reported, and missing gusts remain unavailable.

CZ.name: Czech Hydrometeorological Institute / ČHMÚ
CZ.period: Ten-minute mean wind (Fprum), maximum gust (Fmax), and mean wind direction. Published hourly with UTC observation times; provisional. Suspect, estimated and missing values are excluded.

GR.name: Hellenic National Meteorological Service (HNMS), Greece / official SYNOP and airport observations
GR.period: Official national station wind, supplemented by WMO SYNOP and airport METAR/SPECI observations. Native observation times and periods are retained; reports are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Gusts are included only when explicitly reported, and missing gusts remain unavailable.

DE.name: DWD Climate Data Center
DE.period: 10-minute mean wind and maximum wind speed over the same ten-minute period; UTC observation time; provisional.

BY.name: Belhydromet / official station map and SYNOP via NOAA

stations.period: Reported station wind speed in m/s; SYNOP winds are ten-minute means. Gusts are reported SYNOP maxima: 910 is the preceding ten minutes; 911 is the preceding six hours at 00/06/12/18 UTC or three hours at intermediate SYNOP times. Reports with other gust reference periods are excluded. Native observation times; three-hourly reports can be up to four hours old and are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Missing gusts remain unavailable; no daily maxima or model values are substituted.

stations.period: Reported station wind speed in m/s; SYNOP winds are ten-minute means. Gusts are reported SYNOP maxima: 910 is the preceding ten minutes; 911 is the preceding six hours at 00/06/12/18 UTC or three hours at intermediate SYNOP times. Reports with other gust reference periods are excluded. Native observation times; three-hourly reports can be up to four hours old and are marked delayed after 90 minutes. Missing gusts remain unavailable; no daily maxima or model values are substituted.
